text.en: In a soup, add spinach after the liquid has come to the boil.
text.de: In einer Suppe den Spinat zugeben, nachdem die Flüssigkeit aufgekocht ist.

why.en: Soft and leafy vegetables usually go in after the liquid has come to the boil.
why.de: Weiches und Blattgemüse kommt üblicherweise erst dazu, wenn die Flüssigkeit kocht.

sources.title: Flavors of the Saucier: Stocks, Sauces and Soups (Zeringue and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: Soft and leafy vegetables are usually added to the soup after the liquid is brought to a boil.

sources.title: Flavors of the Saucier: Stocks, Sauces and Soups (Zeringue and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: Both hard vegetables (for example, celery and squash) and soft or leafy vegetables (for example, spinach, corn, broccoli and asparagus) are used for cream soups.
